controls.name: C-7d
controls.query:
FROM logs-system.auth-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= "2026-07-18T10:03:30.000Z" AND @timestamp < "2026-07-18T11:03:30.000Z"
        AND host.name == "db-1"
        AND event.outcome == "failure"
| STATS failed = COUNT(*) BY source.ip, user.name
| SORT failed DESC
